title: If you don't have much time, skip the pencil and draw with a brush
content: With only a few minutes to paint a man in a diner, I have to decide which tool to start with tool to start with, a pencil or a brush?In this new YouTube video, I opt for the brush and dive right in.The advantage of drawing with the brush is that you can get lines or tones of any lightness or darkness.----The #6 round brush I start with is byRicheson / Quiller
